items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I hear that Elvin is sick.

ctx.x: Oh, a fabulous life, I’d say. You have met a lot of – all the people we’ve talked about in the last part of this conversation, these were all from the ’40s, Bird and Mulligan and of course Gil Evans and Miles.
I hear that Elvin is sick.
